name: @lib/service-kit
description: The Rust services' shared runtime: telemetry, rate limits and the vault fallback for secrets. Its flow tests (tests/flow_*.rs) drive each through its public entry point; without this manifest no CI stage runs them.

scripts.test:flow: cargo test --locked -p service-kit --test flow_rate_limit --test flow_secrets --test flow_telemetry --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml
